appDescription: An EV charging assistant that finds the charging stop with the shortest total trip time by predicting charger availability and waiting time at arrival.

function.name: CHECK_ARRIVAL_CHANCE
function.description: Estimates the probability of reaching the current navigation destination with the remaining battery, and the expected battery level at arrival.

function.name: RECOMMEND_CHARGING_STOP
function.description: Recommends the best fast-charging stop on the route to the current destination, considering real-time charger availability, waiting time and arrival probability.

addAsWaypoint.description: Whether to add the recommended charging station to the navigation route as a waypoint.

function.name: FIND_NEARBY_CHARGER
function.description: Finds fast chargers near the current location that are available now, ordered by availability, waiting time and distance.
